events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today! From Oasis anthems to his solo hits, his distinctive voice and swagger have defined generations of British music. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975, four years after its original US release and album debut.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon's powerful solo single 'Imagine' was released in the UK, its message of peace and unity still resonates globally. A true classic.

events.title: 25 Years Since the First iPod Unveiling
events.blurb: Twenty-five years ago this month, Apple unveiled the first iPod, revolutionising how we listened to music by putting '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? Twenty-five years ago this month, Apple introduced the game-changing device that put a thousand songs in your pocket and reshaped the music world forever. What was on your first playlist?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's Global James Bond Day, celebrating over six decades of the world's most famous secret agent. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of legendary musician, songwriter, and peace activist John Lennon, born in Liverpool in 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His vision for peace and his incredible musical legacy continue to inspire generations. What's the John Lennon song that means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From silly walks to classic hotelier antics, his unique brand of British humour has given us countless laughs. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: Anniversary of The Beatles' 'White Album' release
events.blurb: The Beatles' ambitious double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but known as the 'White Album', was released on November 22, 1968, showcasing a diverse range of styles.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed their sprawling 'White Album' on the world. A truly groundbreaking record that pushed boundaries and featured some of their most iconic tracks. What's your top pick from the double LP?

events.title: 35 Years Since Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost one of its most electrifying performers, Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years since his passing. His incredible voice, flamboyant stage presence, and timeless songs continue to captivate millions. Forever a legend.

events.title: 61 Years of The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul'
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul', featuring tracks like 'Norwegian Wood' and 'In My Life', was released in the UK on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that marked a significant artistic leap and influenced countless artists. A true masterpiece. Which track stands out for you?

events.title: 46 Years Since John Lennon's Death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, the visionary artist, songwriter, and peace activist, who was fatally shot in New York City in 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on from his passing. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally, leaving an indelible mark on culture and society.
